measure.measure_definition: Time to event: randomization to first clinically meaningful deterioration in EORTC QLQ-C30 physical functioning score confirmed at next available assessment at least 14 days apart.; Participants; EORTC QLQ-C30 is a 30-item self-administered questionnaire with multi-item functional and symptom scales; the physical functioning scale score is transformed to a 0-100 range with higher scores indicating better functioning. Time to deterioration is assessed from randomization to confirmed deterioration, with maximum follow-up up to primary completion date 18 March 2024 (approximately 43.85 months).; Time origin: date of randomization. Event: first clinically meaningful deterioration in EORTC QLQ-C30 physical functioning score confirmed at the next available assessment at least 14 days apart, regardless of whether the participant withdrew from study treatment or received another anticancer therapy prior to deterioration. Clinically meaningful deterioration is a decrease of at least 10 points from baseline, confirmed at the next available assessment at least 14 days later. Participants with a single deterioration and no further assessments were treated as deteriorated in the reported analysis. Participants without clinically meaningful deterioration were censored at their last evaluable PRO assessment. If first confirmed deterioration followed at least two consecutive missed PRO visits and was at least 48 days after the last assessment before the gap, censoring was at that last evaluable assessment before the gap. Participants with no evaluable visits, missing baseline or post-baseline data, or a baseline score precluding 10-point deterioration (symptom score >90 or functional/global health status score <10) were censored at day 1 (randomization).

population.intervention: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) or investigator's choice standard of care chemotherapy (capecitabine, paclitaxel, or nab-paclitaxel).
population.intervention_regimen: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg intravenously once every 3 weeks until disease progression. Comparator: Treatment of physician’s choice: oral capecitabine or intravenous paclitaxel/nab-paclitaxel, until disease progression; individual TPC doses and administration intervals not specified in the supplied article.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment assignment across both study arms; analysis set is the combined HER2-low/HER2-ultralow ITT population.; Adults ≥18 years with pathologically documented advanced or metastatic breast cancer; HR-positive disease in the metastatic setting; centrally confirmed HER2-low (IHC 2+/ISH- or IHC 1+) or HER2 IHC >0 <1+ expression on a metastatic-setting tissue sample; no prior HER2-positive disease; no prior chemotherapy for advanced or metastatic breast cancer; disease progression within 6 months of first-line metastatic endocrine therapy plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor OR progression on at least 2 prior lines of endocrine therapy with or without targeted therapy in the metastatic setting (recurrence within the first 24 months of starting adjuvant endocrine therapy counts as one prior line, so these participants require only one line in the metastatic setting); adequate tumor sample and protocol-defined organ and bone marrow function. Key exclusions include ineligibility for all investigator's choice chemotherapy options, significant cardiovascular or lung disease, prior or current interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis, active central nervous system metastases or spinal cord compression, and prior trastuzumab deruxtecan study participation.
population.population_time_frame: Enrollment start 2020-07-24 (actual); primary completion 2024-03-18 (actual); study completion 2026-06-19 (estimated); results first posted 2025-04-02 (actual).
